validation_rules.title: Validation rules
validation_rules.description: Allows you to choose which validations are executed during the payment process.

force.description: Forces a payment validation rule to be executed in a forced state.

skip_account_date_validation.title: Skip account date validation
skip_account_date_validation.description: Determines whether or not to validate the transaction date time against the account creation date time.

instant_clearing.title: Instant clearing
instant_clearing.description: Whether funds are available when payment is posted.
